title: Mechanism of inhibition of TLR4/NFkappaB/NLRP3 inflammatory pathway against AD based on the network pharmacology of Erjing Pills.
authors: Zhang, Chen; Lu, Mingjing; Li, CunNeng; Qi, Chao; Lin, Qian; Huang, LiPing; Ding, Hailing
one_liner_zh: 该文基于网络药理学和分子对接研究二精丸成分抑制TLR4/NF-κB/NLRP3通路抗阿尔茨海默病，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Alzheimer disease is an irreversible neurodegenerative disease, and its pathogenesis involves various mechanisms such as neuroinflammation and beta-amyloid deposition. Erjing Pills can inhibit neuroinflammation by inhibiting toll-like receptor 4/nuclear factor kappa-B/nucleotide-binding domain leucine-rich repeat and pyrin domain-containing protein 3; however, qualitative analysis of the material basis is lacking. Therefore, it is necessary to analyze and explore the material basis of network pharmacology research. This study employed a multifaceted approach, including drug-like screening, molecular docking, and bioinformatic analysis. Preliminary screening identified 59 drug ingredients in Erjing Pills that met the Absorption, Distribution, Metabolism, Excretion and Toxicity screening criteria. Among these, 7 ingredients, including diosgenin, exhibited superior binding properties compared with the positive drugs in molecular docking. Gene ontology annotation and pathway analysis revealed their involvement in crucial biological processes, such as hormone response, insulin resistance, and steroid hormone biosynthesis signaling pathways, which are known for their anti-inflammatory and cognitive enhancement effects. A meta-analysis of relevant literature corroborated the anti-inflammatory activities of diosgenin and 5 other ingredients. These 5 ingredients, with diosgenin as a prominent candidate, exert anti-inflammatory effects by targeting key components of the toll-like receptor 4/nuclear factor kappa-B/nucleotide-binding domain leucine-rich repeat and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 inflammatory pathway, thereby presenting potential efficacy in the treatment of Alzheimer disease.
abstract_zh: 阿尔茨海默病是一种不可逆的神经退行性疾病，其发病机制涉及神经炎症和β-淀粉样蛋白沉积等多种机制。二精丸可通过抑制toll样受体4/核因子kappa-B/核苷酸结合域富含亮氨酸重复序列和含pyrin结构域蛋白3来抑制神经炎症；然而，缺乏物质基础的定性分析。因此，有必要对网络药理学研究的物质基础进行分析和探索。本研究采用多方面方法，包括类药筛选、分子对接和生物信息学分析。初步筛选鉴定出二精丸中59种符合吸收、分布、代谢、排泄和毒性筛选标准的药物成分。其中，包括薯蓣皂苷元在内的7种成分在分子对接中表现出优于阳性药物的结合特性。基因本体注释和通路分析揭示它们参与关键生物过程，如激素反应、胰岛素抵抗和类固醇激素生物合成信号通路，这些过程以其抗炎和认知增强作用而闻名。对相关文献的荟萃分析证实了薯蓣皂苷元和其他5种成分的抗炎活性。这5种成分，以薯蓣皂苷元为突出候选，通过靶向toll样受体4/核因子kappa-B/核苷酸结合域富含亮氨酸重复序列和含pyrin结构域蛋白3炎症通路的关键组分发挥抗炎作用，从而在治疗阿尔茨海默病方面展现出潜在疗效。
